purpose: Source-aware crawl records for the 150 Open Phu Quoc knowledge/content topics. These are research objects, not finished articles.
rules: Do not copy prose from sources.
Store claims, dates, names, aliases, practical facts, operational facts, lore variants, source references and known unknowns.
If sources conflict, preserve both claims and mark DISPUTED or NEEDS_VERIFICATION.
Do not publish an image without provenance and rights information.
Volatile practical data must carry checked/verified timestamps and should not be treated as evergreen.
ONE ENTITY -> ONE CANONICAL ID -> OPERATIONAL + KNOWLEDGE + MEMORY -> MANY SURFACES.
